program.name: Balanced Bodyweight
program.subject: Balanced week
program.blurb: A balanced week with no equipment: bodyweight strength, HIIT and a flow every day.
program.about: Everything in one session, on the floor. Every day has bodyweight strength, a HIIT block and a flow: push-ups with an EMOM and a yoga flow one day, legs with jumps and a long stretch the next. Strength, cardio and mobility, every day, no gear. Both later levels add reps.
program.split: Push, HIIT & yoga / legs, jumps & stretch
